reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that multimedia data mining is a structured extension of traditional data mining, where each modality (spatial, audio, image/video) is treated as an independent but interrelated kernel within a unified framework. This allows for modular processing and integration of heterogeneous data types. The knowledge discovery process acts as a feedback loop, transforming raw data into actionable knowledge. The framework assumes that each modality can be abstracted into a feature space, enabling statistical inference. Failure occurs when modality overlap exceeds thresholds or when data richness is insufficient. The GSI mapping leverages Bayesian inference to compute posterior probabilities over these feature spaces, while GSE uses these results to drive dynamic state transitions based on observed events.
